common.title: Medicine Delivers
common.line: Treatments arrive for diseases previously untreatable, or individually tailored therapies reach ordinary clinical use.

common.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
common.line: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion.

notable.title: Washington Takes the Labs
notable.line: The United States takes its frontier laboratories under direct state control.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Wartime model weapon market
notable.line: Belligerent cyber units hijack unattended frontier training clusters to mint one-shot infrastructure payloads, auctioned as ready-to-run packages that spread beyond the war zone.
